fee_notes: Standard territory (500,000 residents) costs $34,000. Additional territory available at $10,000 per ~100,000 residents, up to $84,000 total for approximately 1 million residents. Waived for existing Dryvebox general managers on first franchise. Non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us an initial franchise fee in the lump sum of $34,000.00 when you sign a franchise agreement. Additionally, You will have the option of buying a larger territory than the standard sized territory, for a price of $10,000 per additional roughly 100,000 residents.
